1. **`new_checkout` on web:** blocked. `opsctl` returned "403: feature flags can only be changed by the release-manager role", so it's still `off`. Someone with the release-manager role needs to run `opsctl config set web new_checkout on`.

**Unneeded restart:** I sent the gateway restart in the same command as the config change, so it ran even though the change had failed. Nothing changed because of it. The gateway is healthy (2 replicas, version 2.8.1) and still uses the old 10s timeout. It will need another restart once the new value is set.

Per the runbook, I didn't use `--force` (it needs written approval from the on-call lead) or try other workarounds, and I didn't modify any files. Once both blockers are cleared, I can finish the changes and run `verify.py` again.
